name: tosaint

quote.zh: 瞻彼闋者，虛室生白，吉祥止止。
quote.en: Look into the empty space: an empty room fills with light, and blessings find their place to dwell.

about: Life passes in the blink of an eye.
If there is anything I truly seek, it is simply a little warmth, and the quiet grace of remembering and being remembered.
